strategy.scope: Bounded October15–17 official Japanese disclosures and same-incident corrections, including the October18 01:45 JST WASABI page update; overlap covers September occurrences and older initial announcements referenced by October followups. Not exhaustive.
queries: Eストアー 2026年10月16日 最終報
発車オーライネット 工房 不正アクセス
WASABI SWITCH 第三報 2026年10月17日
日本郵便 調査請求 2026年10月16日
M3 ACCESS 大和総研 イエローハット ファンケル 公式
rules: Incident facts require full company-authored primary bodies; secondary indexes only discover candidates
One provider incident aggregates explicitly linked downstream disclosures; no duplicate incidents for affected customers
Preserve publication, occurrence, detection, status and review dates separately
Retain confirmed versus possible, original units, bounds, approximations, subsets and unresolved unit discrepancies
No leaked records or attacker-source links
